svg.desc: 1: Auto-approve is None; choose Save or Reject after inspecting the proposed new test file. 2: Check the independent hand calculation and unequal-error expectation of 3.6. 3: Confirm matching two-dimensional inputs are tested for ValueError. 4: Check the CPD Qwen model selector while reviewing this Act-mode file proposal.
